text:
Maya Ramos: Hi team — customer reported duplicate charges when our TS SDK retries POSTs after undici abort/backoff jitter. Happened on Node 20, undici@5.16, sdk@1.4.2. Repro attached.
Ethan Cole: Thanks Maya. Was the request body a stream or a JSON buffer? Any chunked transfer?
Maya Ramos: It was a readable stream (file/upload). They left retry enabled (default) and reused an AbortController across attempts. Customer saw 500 then our client retried and Stripe recorded two charges.
Priya Nair: Classic non-rewindable body + retry problem. We should either buffer or disable retries for non-idempotent methods. What's SDK behavior right now?
Ethan Cole: SDK v1.4.2 currently reuses the same Request object & signal for each retry attempt. With undici + Node 20 GSF changes the signal/body handoff timing can cause the second attempt to proceed with leftover data, leading to duplicate POST.
Maya Ramos: Repro steps I shared in the ticket: 1) Node 20.4 + undici@5.16 2) Disable global fetch polyfills so undici path is exercised 3) Run this script (proxy that returns 500 on first request):

```js
// minimal repro (customer-simplified)
const fs = require('fs');
const {fetch, Request} = globalThis;
let controller = new AbortController();
const req = new Request('https://proxy/pay', { method: 'POST', body: fs.createReadStream('./invoice.json'), signal: controller.signal });
// sdk.send is our TS SDK wrapper with retry enabled by default
await sdk.send(req, { retry: 3 });
```

Maya Ramos: Proxy returns 500 first try, 200 thereafter. Observe two POSTs reach Stripe.
Ethan Cole: Two quick mitigation checks: 1) Try creating a fresh AbortController per retry attempt (controller = new AbortController()) 2) Buffer the stream before retry: const buf = await streamToBuffer(stream); pass buf instead of stream. Both prevented duplicates for me.
Priya Nair: For SDK patch: short-term: detect stream bodies on non-idempotent methods and set retry=0 by default + emit a warning with link to docs. Long-term: add an opt-in "autoBuffer" for small bodies and require idempotency-key header for retries on POST.
Maya Ramos: Customer workaround was to add an idempotency-key header; it prevented duplicate charges. They want an SDK fix so they don't have to change app code.
ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026 (severity: P3) for tracking.
Ethan Cole: Proposed release plan: v1.4.3 - change default behavior to NOT retry POST with stream bodies and log telemetry; v1.5.0 - implement autoBuffer + opt-in config and docs. I'll open PR with tests and a small integration repro harness.
Priya Nair: Tests should include Node 18 vs Node 20 matrix + undici versions to catch signal handoff timing. Include a simulated proxy returning 5xx on first attempt.
Maya Ramos: I'll follow up with the customer and attach the repro script and the temporary mitigation steps. Thanks :thumbsup:
Jordan (customer): Confirmed idempotency-key fixed it for us. Appreciate the triage.
